item.title: [03 Nov] Build a Media Agent: CPU Agent, GPU Models as Tools
item.description:
When: Tuesday 03 November 2026, 17:30
Where: Online
Source: Meetup — Thessaloniki tech · Meetup

Run expensive GPU models only when your agent needs them - Alexey Grigorev and Mikhail Rozhkov Generative media apps don't need a GPU running all the time. The agent itself is cheap: it can run on a CPU, read a brief, and decide what to make. The expensive part - image and speech models - can live on GPUs and be called as tools only when needed. Join this hands-on coding workshop with Alexey Grigorev (DataTalks.Club) and Mikhail Rozhkov (Nebius), where we'll build a small media agent on Nebius: a CPU agent as the control plane, with GPU-hosted models exposed as tools. We'll also compare the two ways to run GPU work - a Serverless Endpoint and a batch Job - by latency and cost per asset. We'l…
